Questions from parents

A little more peace of mind.

What ages is AI Tom Bud designed for?
AI Tom Bud is positioned for children ages 3–12. As with any connected or electronic toy, adult setup and supervision are recommended.
What comes in the box?
The package includes AI Tom Bud, a Quick Start Guide, User Manual, Tom’s Outfit, and a charging cable.
What is the outside made of?
AI Tom Bud features a soft, skin-friendly silicone exterior designed for a comfortable, huggable feel.
How is AI Tom Bud charged?
AI Tom Bud charges through a Type-C port and includes a 2000 mAh battery. Use the included charging cable and follow the User Manual for charging guidance.
Where can I buy AI Tom Bud?
Use any “Buy Now” button on this page to visit the official Amazon product listing. Shop on Amazon.
Who can I contact for help?
For product support, email help@jktom.com. For business inquiries, contact xidong-1@jktom.com.
